# Journal of Capital Markets Studies

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** JCMS
- **Publisher:** Emerald Publishing, in partnership with the Turkish Capital Markets Association (TSPB)
- **ISSN:** 2514-4774 (DOAJ toc URL; second ISSN UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://www.emerald.com/jcms
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED (About page: https://www.emerald.com/jcms/pages/about)

## Scope
Per Emerald's About page: high-quality research in economics and finance with a specific focus on capital markets, and the interface between academic research and practice. Topics include financial instruments, market microstructure, behavioural finance, Islamic finance, capital-markets technology and cybersecurity. Comparative studies with global or regional perspectives are given preference.

## Scope Keywords
capital markets, stock markets, market microstructure, financial instruments, behavioural finance, emerging capital markets, regulation, policy

## Article Types Accepted
- Research paper (empirical or policy-related)
- Literature review
- Case study
- Theoretical contribution
- Book review

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.496; Finance Q2 (Q3 in 2024); Economics and Econometrics Q2 (Q3 in 2024) (scimagojr.com source id 21101218132)
- **Open Access:** Full OA, diamond/platinum — no APC and no submission charge; costs funded by TSPB; CC BY 4.0 (Emerald journal page)
- **Field:** Capital markets / Finance

## Special Notes
Review speed (Emerald journal page, submissions 1 Apr 2024–31 Mar 2025): time to first decision 49 days; acceptance to publication 34 days; DOAJ lists about 12 weeks submission to publication. AI policy: Emerald publisher policy (copy-editing of own text allowed; AI-generated content not permitted; disclose any use in Methods/Acknowledgements; AI not an author). Word limit UNVERIFIED.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** selective (acceptance rate UNVERIFIED)
- **Desk-reject triggers:** out of capital-markets scope (from aims); single-market papers are not excluded, but comparative/regional work is preferred
- **Study-type tolerance:** empirical, policy, theoretical
- **Cascade / transfer:** Emerald finance titles; transfer service UNVERIFIED
